Title: University overview Category: category Information: University of Malakand is a public-sector university in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Pakistan. It was established through a charter issued by the Governor of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa on August 30, 2001 and is recognized by the Higher Education Commission of Pakistan. Source: https://cms.uom.edu.pk/about-us

Title: Vision Category: category Information: University of Malakand's stated vision is to be a world class university that provides education with a global perspective and local focus. Source: https://uom.edu.pk/

Title: Mission Category: category Information: University of Malakand's stated mission is to produce efficient and responsible graduates through research-oriented teaching in an environment that promotes and celebrates peace and diversity. Source: https://uom.edu.pk/

Title: University contact Category: category Information: Address: University of Malakand, Chakdara, Dir Lower, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Pakistan. Admissions email: admissions@uom.edu.pk. Examination email: controller@uom.edu.pk. Main phone: +92-945-920502-03. Source: https://uom.edu.pk/

Title: Faculties Category: category Information: The official faculties page lists Faculty of Arts & Humanities, Faculty of Social Sciences, Faculty of Sciences, Faculty of Biological Sciences, Faculty of Computing Sciences and Engineering, and Faculty of Management Sciences. Source: https://uom.edu.pk/faculties

Title: Computing departments Category: category Information: The Faculty of Computing Sciences and Engineering lists Computer Science & IT, Software Engineering, Cyber Security, Multimedia & Gaming, Artificial Intelligence, Bioinformatics, and Data Science. Source: https://uom.edu.pk/faculties

Title: Arts and Humanities departments Category: category Information: The Faculty of Arts & Humanities lists English, Islamic Studies & Religious Affairs, Pashto & Oriental Languages, Urdu, and Education. Source: https://uom.edu.pk/faculties

Title: Social Sciences departments Category: category Information: The Faculty of Social Sciences lists Archaeology, Journalism & Mass Communication, Political Science, Psychology, Social Work, Sociology, Law, and Criminology. Source: https://uom.edu.pk/faculties
Title: Sciences departments Category: category Information: The Faculty of Sciences lists Chemistry, Geology, Mathematics, Physics, Statistics, and Biochemistry. Source: https://uom.edu.pk/faculties
Title: Biological Sciences departments Category: category Information: The Faculty of Biological Sciences lists Biotechnology, Botany, Pharmacy, and Zoology. Source: https://uom.edu.pk/faculties

Title: Management Sciences departments Category: category Information: The Faculty of Management Sciences lists Commerce & Management Sciences, Economics, and Tourism & Hotel Management. Source: https://uom.edu.pk/faculties

Title: Degree programs Category: category Information: The official degree-programs page lists programs including BBA (Hons), BCS (Hons), BIT (Hons), BS Computer Science, BS Artificial Intelligence, BS Bioinformatics, BS Cyber Security, BS Data Science, BS Software Engineering, BS Statistics, Pharm-D and many other undergraduate and graduate programs. Source: https://uom.edu.pk/degree/programs

Title: Undergraduate admission instructions Category: category Information: Official undergraduate admission instructions state that a single admission form can be used to apply to any three disciplines for admission in a relevant subject. Candidates awaiting HSSC Part-II results may apply subject to stated conditions. Source: https://www.uom.edu.pk/storage/files/news_files/1754467034/1754467034-%5BFILE%5D-Instructions-for-undergraduate-admissions.pdf

Title: Biological programs Category: category Information: Biochemistry, Biotechnology, Botany and Zoology require F.Sc Pre-medical or equivalent with at least 45% marks. Source: https://www.uom.edu.pk/storage/files/news_files/1754467053/1754467053-%5BFILE%5D-Eligiblity-Criteria-for-MPhil-%2C-PhD-%26-BS.pdf

Title: Computing programs Category: category Information: Computer Science, Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence, Bioinformatics, Cyber Security, Data Science, and Multimedia & Gaming require F.Sc pre-engineering, pre-medical or equivalent with at least 50% marks. Pre-medical applicants to Computer Science and IT are offered two Mathematics deficiency courses. Source: https://www.uom.edu.pk/storage/files/news_files/1754467053/1754467053-%5BFILE%5D-Eligiblity-Criteria-for-MPhil-%2C-PhD-%26-BS.pdf

Title: LLB and Pharm-D Category: category Information: 5-year LLB requires FA/FSc or equivalent with at least 45% marks and a qualified LAT test. Pharm-D 5-year requires F.Sc Pre-Medical or equivalent with at least 60% marks. Source: https://www.uom.edu.pk/storage/files/news_files/1754467053/1754467053-%5BFILE%5D-Eligiblity-Criteria-for-MPhil-%2C-PhD-%26-BS.pdf

Title: Semester structure Category: category Information: The Semester Regulations 2024 and Onwards state that an academic year has two regular semesters, Fall and Spring, plus an optional Summer semester. A regular semester is 18 weeks, including 16 weeks reserved for instruction. Source: https://www.uom.edu.pk/storage/downloads/1735629349/1735629349-%5BFILE%5D-Semester-Regulations-2024-and-Onwards-%282%29.pdf

Title: 2025-26 academic calendar Category: category Information: The published academic calendar includes fresh-intake classes beginning September 8, 2025; spring classes beginning January 26, 2026; mid exams March 24-27, 2026; summer semester classes beginning June 8, 2026; and summer final exams in the first week of August. Source: https://uom.edu.pk/index.php/academic/calendar

Title: HEC Merit and Need Based Scholarship Batch 12 Category: category Information: UOM lists the HEC Merit and Need Based Scholarship Program Batch 12 selected-students announcement, published July 7, 2026. Source: https://www.uom.edu.pk/osfa

Title: HEC Need Based Scholarship Batch 12 interviews Category: category Information: UOM lists HEC Need Based Scholarship Program Batch 12 interviews for shortlisted candidates, published June 16, 2026. Source: https://www.uom.edu.pk/osfa

Title: KPEF Merit-cum-Inaffordability Scholarship 2025-26 Category: category Information: UOM guidance says applicants register on the KPEF portal, must be enrolled in first year of BS or MS, belong to Khyber Pakhtunkhwa/Newly Merged Districts, and have at least 70% marks or CGPA 3.00. Source: https://uom.edu.pk/osfa/guideline-for-students-to-apply-for-the-kpef-merit-cum-inaffordability-scholarship-scheme-2025-26

Title: 2026 admission announcement Category: category Information: UOM published an announcement inviting online applications for BS 4-year, MPhil/PhD, LLB and Pharm-D 5-year, B.Ed, and Associate Degree in Education programs on June 18, 2026. Source: https://uom.edu.pk/index.php/news/online-applications-are-invited-for-admission-in-bs4-year-mphilphd-llb-pharm-d-5-year-bed-and-associate-degree-in-education

Title: 2026-27 main campus merit lists Category: category Information: The final merit-list page for BS Session 2026-2027 lists program-specific merit-list files including Artificial Intelligence, Bioinformatics, Cyber Security, Data Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, Computer Science, Statistics, Pharm-D and many other programs. Source: https://uom.edu.pk/news/final-merit-list-of-main-campus-for-bs-session-2026-2027

Title: Official downloads collection Category: category Information: The UOM Downloads page provides official Acts, statutes, regulations, by-laws, academic rules, eligibility documents, admission forms, fee structure documents, budgets, annual reports, anti-plagiarism policies and other university forms. Source: https://uom.edu.pk/downloads
